mapper.sql: EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dispatch d WHERE d.id = ( SELECT MAX(d2.id) FROM dispatch d2 WHERE d2.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND d2.workitem_id = w.id AND d2.is_deleted = 0 ) AND d.status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND d.is_deleted = 0 )

NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM status_node sn WHERE sn.id = w.status_node_id AND ( UPPER(COALESCE(sn.category, '')) = 'DONE' OR UPPER(COALESCE(sn.code, '')) LIKE '%DONE%' OR UPPER(COALESCE(sn.code, '')) LIKE '%CLOSED%' OR UPPER(COALESCE(sn.code, '')) LIKE '%RELEASED%' OR COALESCE(sn.name, '') LIKE '%完成%' OR COALESCE(sn.name, '') LIKE '%关闭%' OR COALESCE(sn.name, '') LIKE '%发布%' OR UPPER(COALESCE(sn.name, '')) LIKE '%DONE%' OR UPPER(COALESCE(sn.name, '')) LIKE '%CLOSED%' OR UPPER(COALESCE(sn.name, '')) LIKE '%RELEASED%' ) )

EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM status_node snc WHERE snc.id = w.status_node_id AND ( snc.name LIKE '%完成%' OR snc.name LIKE '%关闭%' OR snc.name LIKE '%发布%' OR UPPER(snc.name) LIKE '%DONE%' OR UPPER(snc.name) LIKE '%CLOSED%' OR UPPER(snc.name) LIKE '%PUBLISHED%' ) )

EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM status_node snc WHERE snc.id = w.status_node_id AND ( snc.name LIKE '%执行%' OR snc.name LIKE '%开发%' OR snc.name LIKE '%验证%' OR UPPER(snc.name) LIKE '%PROGRESS%' OR UPPER(snc.name) LIKE '%RUNNING%' ) )

( ( w.assignee_type = 'HUMAN' AND AND ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM status_node snc WHERE snc.id = w.status_node_id AND ( snc.name LIKE '%决策%' OR snc.name LIKE '%审核%' OR snc.name LIKE '%阻塞%' OR UPPER(snc.name) LIKE '%DECISION%' OR UPPER(snc.name) LIKE '%REVIEW%' ) ) )
